source.name: Dubai Media Office, Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism partners with Dubai Basketball
source.quote: The Dubai logo and visitdubai.com website also now features on the back of the team's shirts

note: Founding sponsor; Dubai logo and visitdubai.com on the back of the shirts (January 2025). The club store's photo of the back of the 2026/27 home jersey (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC05168.jpg) shows Equiti between the name and the number and the word 'DUBAI' under the number, not the Dubai logo with visitdubai.com. Whether the deal has ended isn't sourced.
